lines.speaker: therapist
lines.text: Welcome back, Bill. Last time you tried the first minute of your talk here. How has the week been?

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: Mixed. I practised the talk twice at home, and that went fine. But on Thursday I skipped the seminar because I knew I'd have to speak.

lines.speaker: therapist
lines.text: Practising twice is real work. What happened on Thursday morning, before you decided to stay away?

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: I woke up with my stomach in knots. I kept picturing everyone staring at me, and I couldn't face it.

lines.speaker: therapist
lines.text: So the picture of everyone staring came first, and then the urge to stay away. How did you feel once you'd decided?

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: Relieved for an hour or so. Then I felt like a failure for the rest of the day.
lines.raw: Relieved for an hour or so. Then I felt like a failure for the rest of the day. *sighs*

lines.speaker: therapist
lines.text: Relief first, then a heavy feeling afterwards. Next week, shall we plan the seminar together, one step at a time?
